notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody! 

Update 1.2 is out now and it brings a lot of changes to the game, such as:

-Gamepad control, now the game can be fully completed from start to finish on any gamepad

-Fixed the display of dialog text, now the texts have a fixed size and will not change dynamically

-Fixed minor bugs that you may not have noticed :)

The update has affected the demo version as well, so if you haven't purchased Life of Slime yet, please try out the demo version.

notes.title: The release of the first big game!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!! 

We have recently released our first big game. If you bought and enjoyed the game then we are very happy for you and very grateful to you, without you we can't continue to make great games. If you haven't bought the game yet, we really ask you to do so - everyone's contribution to the future of the studio is very important, especially now, when it is just about to be decided.

notes.title: Release of the demo version of our first big game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Last week we released a demo version of our first big game, this is the one that should reveal us to the big video game world. We have high hopes for this game, so please add the game to your wish list, it will help a lot in promoting the game.

The full version of the game is likely to be released by the end of next month, will cost $ 5, will be passed in 2-3 hours and give you a variety of emotions.

Development of the game started a year ago, the whole time we were hoping for a speedy release, posting news about the game's postponement. First, the release was scheduled for last July, then for December, now it is indefinite and will be announced only when the game is fully ready and sent to the stores for publication. Now the game is closer than ever to release and we ask you to join our discord community in order not to miss any news.
